name: ActionMenu
description: The row ⋯ menu (R12.1): a ghost icon button that opens every action for the row.
signature: <T>({ set, targets, label, size, trigger, align }: ActionMenuProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element | null

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the overlay relative to its anchor.

props.name: label
props.description: The target's name, for the trigger's accessible name: "Actions for NST-C106".

props.name: set
props.description: Shared action definitions used by menus, headers and the command palette.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: targets
props.description: Selected entities passed to action visibility, enablement, confirmation and execution.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Replace the ⋯ trigger (it must forward its ref and spread props).
